items.q: Where are higher-pitched notes written on the stave?
items.why: The vertical position on the stave shows pitch: higher notes sit higher.

items.q: Which lasts longer, a minim or a crotchet?
items.correct: A minim (2 beats) lasts longer than a crotchet (1 beat).
items.misconception: A crotchet lasts longer than a minim.
items.why: Note values set duration: a minim is held for two beats, a crotchet for one.
